title: Het kiezen van een huisarts 1974
authors: Weeder, W.E., Rijksuniversiteit Groningen * Groningen, Sociologisch instituut (primary investigator)
descriptions: Factors considered by the inhabitants of a new neighbourhood in Groningen in choosing a group practice or a G.P. working on his own / opinions on group practices / satisfaction with G.P. / frequency of consulting G.P. / data on migration to new neighbourhood / motivations for not having chosen a G.P. yet. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education/ consumption of durables
